summary.headline: Tail Through the Zodiac Signs
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the Tail’s entry into Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, and Aquarius, including political unrest, disease, crop failure, weather, earthquakes, famine, and deaths. Taj al-Din Akram gives an additional Saturn conjunction warning for Scorpio, with conditions in Hamadan and nearby regions comparatively better.
